title: Official scores on the comparator ensemble grid

quantities.official_score: official test metric of the comparator's E-member ensemble with the paired seed structure of the ensemble_grid set (percent or F1 points; AP in native units)

notes: Companion of the ensemble_grid set (same checkpoints, same E grid 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 and the same test inputs): ensemble_grid holds the comparator loss, this set the official score of the same ensembles. Scores are recomputed from each ensemble's saved test predictions with the official metric (cross_morse.evaluation.score_observations) and written with the SHA-256 of the predictions under raw/; deposit with `python -B scripts/export_records.py from-mapping --mapping <ensemble_grid_scores mapping>` once the set is registered for the mapping exporter.
